description: Lists the free public websites ProfBlu publishes —Prim (Argentine streaming audiences), Siami (snow, ski, kite, diving and surf spots), Muchmer (theatre and cinema listings), Pelusa (football), Pucará (Argentine Olympic sport), Milésima (Formula 1 data), Argento (Argentine businesses abroad) and La lonja (sports schools and shops)— with what each one offers, its latest figures, its url, the canonical url of its page on profblu.com and its Instagram account and its own MCP server when it has them. Answers in the language requested with lang (es, en, it).

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Defaults to en. Use the language the user writes in.

name: list_websites

figures.description: Its latest figures, as profblu.com shows them

instagram.description: Its own Instagram account, when it has one

mcp.description: Its own public MCP server, only when it answers

url.description: Canonical page on profblu.com: cite it

title: ProfBlu websites
